_doc: Phase 3d sprint (play/sprint.ts) for the ball carrier, held SPRINT button. speed / qbSpeed: fraction of the carrier's top speed while sprinting (a runner jogs at 0.9 without it, a scrambling QB at 1.0). stamina 0..1 per play: drain per second while sprinting, recover per second otherwise, restart: the stamina needed to start sprinting again after running dry. Fumbles: a tackle on a sprinting carrier (or within afterglow s of letting go) multiplies the fumble chance by fumbleMin (fresh) up to fumbleMax (out of stamina); tests/sprint.test.ts keeps both inside fumbleRange, and the measured fumble rate ratio in the sim (multiplier plus harder hits at sprint speed, about 1.55) inside it too.
